instruction: Candid outdoor photograph of four friends sitting side-by-side on a green grassy lawn in a park. From left to right, the Asian man in the red 'T' shirt (R3) sits smiling and pointing to his chest; the woman in the dark blue 'E' shirt (R4) leans back laughing and pointing to her shirt; the Black woman with an afro in the red 'A' shirt (R6) sits cross-legged gesturing to her shirt; and the bald man in the blue 'M' shirt (R2) sits on the far right pointing to his chest with both hands. Together their shirts spell 'TEAM'. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows on the grass.
elements: R3 smiles and points to his own chest, rather than R4 doing that exact action
R2 points to his own chest with both hands, rather than R6 doing the two-handed chest-pointing
R4 leans back laughing while pointing to her shirt, rather than R3 taking that leaning-back laughing role
R6 sits cross-legged while gesturing to her shirt
the labeled shirts together spell TEAM
the group sits on a green grassy lawn in a park
